periods.name: 孟买至赞达剌巴士之旅
periods.summary: The retrieval team rents a worn Tata minibus, travels north through India, experiences traffic chaos, reckless bus racing, rural roads and finally reaches Zandra with the vehicle needing repair.
periods.outcome: Team establishes a base at Singh hotel/restaurant/garage in Zandra.
